test_title: PYST 07: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

While she / was watched / the movie, / her phone rang.
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. was watched .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the past continuous tense, describing an action that was happening when another action occurred.
 
• In past continuous tense, the correct structure is **"was/were + present participle (verb+ing)".**
 
• The segment **"was watched"** is incorrect because **"watched" is** the past tense form of the verb and does not fit the continuous tense structure.
 
• The correct form should be "was watching". Therefore, the segment "was watched" contains the grammatical error.

Correct sentence: *While she was watching the movie, her phone rang.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Past Continuous Tense:**

 
 
• **Structure:** Subject + was/were + verb (base form + ing)
 
• **Example:** He was playing when it started to rain.
 
• **Usage:** Describes an ongoing action in the past that was interrupted by another action.
 
 
 
• **Present Participle (verb+ing):** The form of the verb used to indicate continuous action.
